terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.section1Text: You agree to use this website only for lawful purposes and in a way that does not infringe upon the rights of others
terms.section2Text: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account information
terms.section3Text: All orders are subject to acceptance. We reserve the right to refuse or cancel any order
terms.section4Text: Prices are subject to change without notice. Products are available while supplies last
terms.section5Text: Dawar Kitchen is not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from your use of this website
terms.section6Text: These terms are governed by the laws of Egypt
terms.section7Text: Any disputes will be resolved through informal negotiation or mediation
terms.section8Text: We may update these terms at any time. Your continued use constitutes acceptance
terms.questionsText: We're here to help. Contact us at info@dawarkitchen.com
terms.intro: Welcome to Dawar Kitchen. By using our website and placing orders, you agree to comply with and be bound by the following terms and conditions.
terms.section2Item1: Orders must be placed within our designated operating hours and delivery zones.
terms.section2Item2: Delivery times are estimates and may vary due to Cairo traffic conditions.
terms.section2Item3: Special dietary requirements or delivery instructions must be specified during checkout.
terms.section2Item4: Cancellations must be communicated to our team prior to food preparation.
terms.section3Item1: All menu prices are displayed in Egyptian Pounds (EGP).
terms.section3Item2: Payment can be made online via secure card processing or cash on delivery.
terms.section3Item3: We reserve the right to revise prices and item availability without prior notice.
terms.section3Item4: Refunds for eligible cancelled orders will be processed using the original payment method.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Account: Account data: email address, name, and phone number
privacy.section1Order: Order information: delivery addresses, preferences, and history
privacy.section1Device: Device data: IP address, browser type, and pages visited
privacy.section2Improve: To improve our service and user experience
privacy.section2Marketing: To send promotional emails (with your consent)
privacy.section3Disclosure: We do not sell your personal data. We only share information with service providers who assist in order fulfillment
privacy.section4Security: We use industry-standard encryption to protect your data
privacy.section5Access: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data
privacy.section6Retention: We retain order data for accounting purposes and personal data until you request deletion
privacy.section7Changes: We may update this policy. Changes will be posted on this page
privacy.questionsText: We're happy to help. Contact us at info@dawarkitchen.com
privacy.intro: At Dawar Kitchen, we value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data.
privacy.section1Reservation: Reservation / Order Information (date, time, portions, delivery address)
privacy.section1Contact: Contact Inquiry Details (messages sent through our contact form)
privacy.section1Technical: Technical & Browsing Data (IP address, browser type, cookies)
privacy.section2Item1: Process and fulfill your catering & delivery orders across Cairo
privacy.section2Item2: Communicate with you regarding order confirmations and updates
privacy.section2Item3: Improve our kitchen menu, customer service, and platform performance
privacy.section2Item4: Send essential operational notifications and announcements
privacy.section2Item5: Ensure security and prevent fraudulent platform activity
privacy.section3Text: We never sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We only share data with trusted delivery partners or when required by Egyptian law.
privacy.section4Text: We implement robust administrative, technical, and physical security measures to safeguard your personal data from unauthorized access or disclosure.
privacy.section5Intro: Under applicable data protection guidelines, you have the right to:
privacy.section5Item1: Request access to your stored personal information
privacy.section5Item2: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
privacy.section5Item3: Request deletion of your personal account data
privacy.section5Item4: Opt-out of non-essential communications at any time
privacy.section5Item5: Withdraw consent for data processing where applicable
privacy.section5ContactText: To exercise any of these rights, please contact our team at
privacy.section6Text: We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy, unless a longer retention period is required by law.
privacy.section7Text: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.

hero.subtitle: Authentic Egyptian & Syrian flavors, crafted with fire and passion by women who cook from heritage. Delivered warm across Cairo.

about.aboutDesc: Dawar Kitchen is a social enterprise in Ezbet Khairallah, Cairo, where Syrian and Egyptian women craft authentic dishes rooted in heritage. Every meal supports fair employment, vocational training, and cross-cultural exchange through food.
about.recipesDesc: Time-honored Syrian and Egyptian recipes passed down through generations.
about.ingredientsDesc: Locally sourced produce, chosen daily for quality and freshness.
about.flavorsDesc: Spices and techniques that bring every dish to life with authentic taste.
about.fairWorkDesc: Empowering women through dignified work, training, and participatory decision-making.
about.supportMessage: Every order you place directly supports fair employment and vocational training for women in our community.

chefs.heading: Meet Our Chefs
chefs.description: Talented women from Syria and Egypt, bringing their heritage, skills, and passion to every dish.
